we have designed a number of redox-silence tocotrienol derivatives with potent antiproliferation activities and have identified the important structural features for this activity.

steric bulk and HBD and HBA properties of the substituent at the C-6 position of VE analogues are important in determining the biological activity of these compounds.
the 6-carbonyl group is an important structural feature for antiproliferation and invasion activity.
a combination of steric and HBD properties at the C-6 position of VE analogues are important for antiproliferation and anti-invasion.
